name: Camp Clifton
description_short: Full day Boys & Girls Club camp for members ages 6 to 14 (from 1st grade) at the Clifton clubhouse, 8:30 to 5:30 in one week sessions. Campers are grouped by age with a group leader, swim in the club pool, and can sign up for paid trips to water parks, amusement parks and bowling.
refund_policy_summary: A nonrefundable deposit equal to one month's tuition is applied to the final month. Withdrawals must be filed 30 days before the final month; refunds come as portal credit, or less $10 by other means.
notes: $160 a week for the first child and $150 for each additional child, plus a nonrefundable club membership of $40 ($30 per additional child). Clifton residents who meet income rules can apply for a limited number of scholarships or a $110 reduced weekly rate. Trips cost extra ($10 to $50) and need a $10 trip shirt. Lunch and snack are provided free Monday to Friday. Up to 240 campers a week, groups at 15 to 1. All applicants go on a waitlist until space is confirmed. The club also runs Kinderkare Camp for kindergartners ($800 a month) and Camp Gingerbread for ages 2.5 to 4 ($850 a month) on the same dates.
